status.hint: The app backs up your cards by itself and checks that every backup opens again.

status.verified_bad: {problems} problems found in the backup. Make a new one.

status.mirror_ok_empty: Second location: ready · no copy yet
status.mirror_missing: The second backup folder was not found: {folder}. Is the drive connected?
status.mirror_unwritable: Cannot write to the second backup folder: {folder}. Check permissions and free space.
status.mirror_inside_collection: The second backup folder is inside the collection folder: {folder}. Put it on another drive.
status.mirror_failed: The last copy to the second location failed ({date}).
status.mirror_off: No second backup location; you can set another drive below.

auto_backup.label: Automatic backups
auto_backup.description: Backs up the whole collection, media included, into the backups folder next to it and checks each copy by restoring it into a scratch copy. Only copies that pass are kept.

auto_backup_keep.label: Automatic copies to keep
auto_backup_keep.description: Older checked copies are removed once a new one has passed its check. The newest good copy is never deleted.

backup_mirror_dir.label: Second backup folder
backup_mirror_dir.description: On another drive or in a synced folder (OneDrive, Dropbox): every backup is also copied there and checked. The folder must already exist. Leave empty to turn it off.
